title: Brain Scans Found Dim Frontal Brakes, Yet Two Peaceful Professors Had That Same Scan
description:
You think a brain scan can spot a born criminal! Yet two peaceful professors found that scan inside their heads! This is the true story of Adrian Raine's Brain Scan Study. Here is what went wrong with born-criminal myths.
